review_policy.structured_scope: gold is extracted only from target_document; other PN and DS do not fill missing values

review_policy.raw_reference: all offsets must validate against the SHA-256 of the full raw line
review_policy.audit_basis: PN is the primary evidence; source_ds_refs only records the claim origin
review_policy.deduplication: new structured items use a different PN and new audits use a different claim from the existing item for that episode
review_policy.label_balance: the five added audits cover each allowed label once, producing two items per label overall
